description: Copy all effects (or a specific effect) from one clip to another. Does not copy intrinsic properties like Motion/Opacity unless specified.

effect_name.description: Specific effect display name to copy (copies all non-intrinsic effects if omitted)

source_node_id.description: Node ID of the source clip to copy effects from

target_node_id.description: Node ID of the target clip to paste effects to

name: copy_effects_between_clips

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Copy Effects Between Clips
